title: Textbooks Are All You Need
authors: S. Gunasekar, Y. Zhang, J. Aneja, et al. (18 authors)
before: Capability was assumed to track parameters and raw token count.
problem: Web text is repetitive and much of it teaches the model very little.
breakthrough: Train a 1.3B model on a small corpus of textbook-quality and synthetic data, and beat far larger models at code.
why: It made data quality a first-class scaling variable and legitimised synthetic pretraining data.
next: The phi series, and synthetic data pipelines across the industry.
inherits: Curated and synthetic data as a substitute for raw scale.
